title: Wear app: Double-tab settings crash when scrolling down to end
symptom: When scrolling down beyond 'Show Loop Status' in the settings menu on the watch face, the config page crashes back to the watch face.
fix: Uninstall the wear app and install it again. The user had to uninstall/reinstall twice before it stopped crashing, but it later started crashing again.
evidence_quote: uninstall wear app and install again
